subject: Great American Beer Hall Site Plan Review
overview: The Community Development Board conducted a site plan review for a new 22,025 square foot beer hall at 142 Mystic Avenue. The board approved the project with seventeen conditions following an extensive debate regarding incomplete design documentation and the developer's urgent project deadlines.

items.title: 142 Mystic Avenue Site Plan Review
items.summary: Approved the site plan for the Great American Beer Hall subject to seventeen conditions, including a requirement for the developers to return for a future review of professional landscape and engineering plans. The board and residents discussed concerns regarding site circulation, noise, and pedestrian safety on the Mystic Avenue corridor.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the October 12 meeting with one correction.

items.title: Planning Office Update
items.summary: Planning Director Alicia Hunt reported on the reclassification of a senior planner position and the upcoming recruitment for a housing planner.
